# opnsense_firewall_npt (Data Source)

NPTv6 rules translate an internal IPv6 prefix to an external one (RFC 6296), one-to-one and without keeping state.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the NPT rule.

### Read-Only

- `categories` (Set of String) UUIDs of the firewall categories this rule belongs to.
- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `destination_net` (String) External IPv6 prefix.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this rule is enabled.
- `interface` (String) Interface the translation happens on.
- `log` (Boolean) Whether matching packets are logged.
- `sequence` (Number) Order in which rules are evaluated.
- `source_net` (String) Internal IPv6 prefix.
- `track_interface` (String) Interface whose delegated prefix is used as the external prefix.
